features.title: The core principles
features.description: These convictions shape every feature — so the team stays in sync and the room stays in worship.

singleSource.title: Single Source of Truth
singleSource.summary: Update a song or set once and everyone receives the same version.
description: Different charts create confusion. A late set change should not mean chasing musicians and sending revised slides back and forth with the AV team.
Worship Viewer keeps one definitive version of every song and set in one place.
Each team member can view that source in the format they need — sheets, slides, or another supported view — on their own device. Update it once, and the change reaches everyone.

preparedYetFree.title: Prepared yet Free
preparedYetFree.summary: Plan every detail without locking your team into an inflexible performance.
description: Worship teams often feel forced to choose between detailed preparation and complete spontaneity.
Many professional tools help plan a service precisely, but that structure can make it harder to respond freely in the moment.
Worship Viewer lets you prepare the details while keeping every part of the set flexible, so your team can change direction without losing clarity.

allForHisGlory.title: All for His Glory
allForHisGlory.summary: Technology is not the center of worship; it should quietly serve the One who is.
description: “For from him and through him and for him are all things. To him be the glory forever! Amen.” — Romans 11:36
That is true of everything, including this app. Its purpose is not profit, novelty, or musical polish for its own sake. Its purpose is to glorify God.
It is His project. Building and using it should be an act of worship to the one God — Father, Son, and Holy Spirit.
